glosses: pent, shut-in, cooped up, locked up, locked down confined, holed up, shut away
stuck, trapped (e.g. stuck in a room, office, elevator, etc.)

examples.text: No quiero pasar las vacaciones encerrada en casa.
examples.en: I don't want to spend my vacations locked inside my house.

examples.text: ¡No puedo soportar estar encerrado en esta prisión!
examples.en: I can't stand being cooped up in this prison!

examples.text: El gato se quedó encerrado en el armario. ¿Lo puedes sacar?
examples.en: The cat got locked in the closet. Can you let it out?

words.g: to put out, to get out

examples.text: Tom se quedó encerrado fuera de su pieza.
examples.en: Tom locked himself out of his room.
